svg.title: Behringer NEUTRON connections
svg.desc: Connection inventory. Arrows indicate signal direction relative to the instrument. Locations identify hardware faces; the diagram is not a socket placement drawing. Physical control sections are listed below.
svg.text: Arrows are relative to the device. Locations name the hardware face; sockets are grouped by function.
PHYSICAL CONTROLS / see interface.svg for labelled positions
OSC 1 / OSC 2: Tune 1, Osc mix, Tune 2, Shape 1, Range 1, Shape 2, Width 1, Osc sync, Width 2, Paraphonic
VCF: Mode, Frequency, Resonance, Mod depth, Env depth, Key track
DELAY / OVERDRIVE: Time, Repeats, Mix, Drive, Tone, Level
OUTPUT / UTILITY: Volume, MIDI IN, S/H rate, S/H glide, Slew, Porta time, Attenuator 1, Attenuator 2

PATCH INPUTS: OSC 1, OSC 2, OSC 1+2, INVERT IN, SHAPE 1, SHAPE 2, PW 1, PW 2, VCF FREQ, FREQ MOD, RES, OD IN, VCA IN, VCA CV, DELAY IN, DELAY TIME, E.GATE 1, E.GATE 2, S&H IN, S&H CLOCK, LFO RATE, LFO
SHAPE, LFO TRIG, MULT IN, ATT 1 IN, ATT 1 CV, ATT 2 IN, SLEW IN, SUM 1 A, SUM 1 B, SUM 2 A, SUM 2 B
PATCH OUTPUTS: OSC 1, OSC 2, OSC MIX, VCF 1, VCF 2, OVERDRIVE, VCA, OUTPUT, NOISE, ENV 1, ENV 2, INVERT, LFO, LFO UNI, S&H, MULT 1, MULT 2, MIDI GATE, ATT 1, ATT 2, SLEW, SUM 1, SUM 2, ASSIGN
